pin_title: When to Photograph Birds in Costa Rica | Seasonal Patterns
pin_description: From January Quetzals to December Scarlet Macaws — the complete seasonal bird photography calendar for Costa Rica.

pin_title: Monteverde Cloud Forest Wildlife Photography | Costa Rica Nature Photos
pin_description: Discover Monteverde through a wildlife photographer's lens. 200+ cloud forest photos with expert advice on birding trails, Quetzal spots, and atmospheric fog photography. See more at WildPhotography.com.

pin_title: Scarlet Macaw Photography | Costa Rica's Most Colorful Bird
pin_description: Scarlet Macaws in Costa Rica photographed at their Carara and Osa Peninsula feeding trees. Complete guide to finding, approaching, and capturing these vivid parrots. See more at WildPhotography.com.

pin_title: Resplendent Quetzal Photography | Costa Rica Cloud Forest Birds
pin_description: The Resplendent Quetzal is the jewel of Costa Rica birding. Learn when, where, and how to photograph this iridescent cloud forest trogon in the highlands. See more at WildPhotography.com.

pin_title: Carara National Park Wildlife Photography | Scarlet Macaw Photos Costa Rica
pin_description: Photograph Scarlet Macaws, crocodiles, and tropical birds at Carara. This accessible Pacific rainforest delivers some of Costa Rica's best wildlife encounters near San Jose. See more at WildPhotography.com.

pin_title: Drake Bay Costa Rica Wildlife Photography | Osa Peninsula Access Point
pin_description: Drake Bay is your gateway to Costa Rica's wildest coast. Photograph humpback whales, macaws, and pristine rainforest on the remote Osa Peninsula. See more at WildPhotography.com.

pin_title: Keel-billed Toucan Photography | Costa Rica Lowland Forest Birds
pin_description: The Keel-billed Toucan is one of Costa Rica's most photogenic birds. Find them in the Sarapiqui region and Braulio Carrillo with this photographer's field guide. See more at WildPhotography.com.

pin_title: Magnificent Frigatebird Photography | Pacific Coast Seabird Costa Rica
pin_description: The Magnificent Frigatebird's four-meter wingspan and aerial mastery make it a compelling subject along Costa Rica's Pacific coast beaches and offshore islands. See more at WildPhotography.com.

pin_title: Tortuguero Costa Rica Wildlife Photography | Sea Turtle Nesting Beach
pin_description: Tortuguero on the Caribbean coast is famous for sea turtle nesting and canal wildlife. Canon and heron photography at dawn in one of Costa Rica's most productive wetland systems. See more at WildPhotography.com.

pin_title: White-throated Magpie-Jay Photography | Guanacaste Dry Forest Birds
pin_description: The striking White-throated Magpie-Jay is Guanacaste's most recognizable bird. Photograph them in the dry forest around Tamarindo and Palo Verde with local field tips. See more at WildPhotography.com.

pin_title: Anhinga Snakebird Photography | Costa Rica Wetland Birds
pin_description: The Anhinga or Snakebird hunts underwater in Costa Rica's wetlands. Wetland photography guide to this fascinating diving bird found throughout the Caribbean and Pacific lowlands. See more at WildPhotography.com.

pin_title: Best Wildlife Photography Tours in Costa Rica | 2026 Guide
pin_description: Guided wildlife photography tours across Costa Rica. From Tortuguero sea turtles to Guanacaste wetlands and Monteverde cloud forest.

pin_title: Crocodile Photography Guide | Costa Rica Pacific Coast
pin_description: How to photograph American Crocodiles along Costa Rica Pacific coast. Best locations, seasons, and techniques for the Tempisque River and Tarcoles Bridge.

pin_title: Bijagua Costa Rica Photography | Tenorio Volcano Rio Celeste Region
pin_description: Bijagua is the access point for Rio Celeste, one of Costa Rica's most photographed rivers. The vivid blue turquoise water against dark volcanic rock makes for stunning photography.

pin_title: Collared Aracari Photography | Costa Rica Toucan Cloud Forest Guide
pin_description: The Collared Aracari is your best bet for toucan photography in the Monteverde Cloud Forest area. This medium-sized toucan moves through the canopy in family groups. See more at WildPhotography.com.

pin_title: Dominical Costa Rica Photography | Whale Tail Beach and South Pacific Coast
pin_description: Dominical and Uvita on Costa Rica's south Pacific coast offer dramatic coastline photography. The famous whale tail sandbar, Nauyaca waterfalls, and consistent surf action. See more at WildPhotography.com.
